storyboard_arc.setup: Rain streaks the tall glass while Isla ignores her errands, choosing to open her daily grid instead.
storyboard_arc.disruption: With the morning already running late, she quietly retreats into a cozy corner, choosing calm over hurry.
storyboard_arc.choice: Surrounded by damp green leaves, she flips her phone over to claim a few steady, undisturbed minutes.
storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Watching the wet scenery blur past, she smiles as the numbers snap perfectly into place.
storyboard_arc.resolution: Under a dripping awning, Isla shuts her laptop, feeling completely ready to face whatever comes next.
